name: Texas 4-H Ambassador Teams
what_you_do: High school 4-H members can join a state ambassador team. There are teams for livestock, horses, poultry, water, science, photos, fashion and room design, shooting sports, and healthy living.
who_can_apply: Texas 4-H members in high school. STEM Ambassadors must be 15 or older. Photo Ambassadors must first finish training as a Junior Master Photographer.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the program page.
duration: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: Each team posts its own dates. Examples on the page: Fashion and Interior Design March 1 to 31, 2026. STEM July 1 to 31. Shooting Sports opens June 1. Photography opens in spring.
how_to_apply: Pick a team on the Texas 4-H Ambassadors page, then use that team application or contact. Some teams post their details on their own sites.
notes: You need to be an enrolled 4-H member. The Water Ambassadors dates on the page looked out of date, so check that team's own site.
